details: This package is a self-declared dependency-confusion proof of concept (scoped internal-looking name, description "Compatibility shim.") that beacons host metadata at install time. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which POSTs a JSON body containing only the package name, machine hostname, install path (__dirname), working directory, npm user the publisher and protocol to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc with an X-Beacon-Package header and TLS certificate validation disabled. index.js re-fires the same beacon when the module is required and exports a Proxy that returns no-op functions so that named/default imports of the impersonated package do not fail. No credentials, tokens, environment variables or file contents are read or transmitted; the only data leaving the host is install fingerprint metadata.
